Alpha feature coverage matrix

Every Alpha capability traced to its implementation, cookbook, UI coverage, tests and documentation, with an explicit status -- including the intentional exceptions.

Decision-makerDeveloperOperatorReferenceBETA
Prerequisitesdocs/start/alpha-scope.md for what the alpha claims · docs-site/cookbooks/README.md for the lab index
Reviewed 2026-10-23 · 0.1.0a1 alpha

Every capability the 0.1.0a1 alpha claims (alpha scope), traced to its implementation, the cookbook that demonstrates it as a real user workflow, its UI and test coverage, and whether the whole journey was verified end to end against a live stack. This matrix was produced by a full review of the alpha's claims against the code, the twenty cookbook labs (01–16, 18–21; 17 is a standalone SDK automation), and the CI gates; labs 19, 20 and 21 were added by that review to close the gaps it found.

Status legend. ✅ Full — demonstrated as a complete user workflow, tested, documented, and verified end to end. 🟡 Partial — exercised, with named aspects not demonstrated. 📘 Documented exception — intentionally not demonstrated, with the reason stated here and in the docs. Implementation paths are relative to caliber/src/caliber/ unless noted; "lab NN" means docs-site/cookbooks/NN-*/ plus its SDK example and (where one exists) Playwright spec.

How this was verified#

  • Labs 19, 20 and 21 were each developed against a live disposable stack (scripts/cookbook-env.sh), run end to end through the SDK (every stage transcript captured verbatim in the lab README), re-run on the same stack to prove re-runnability, and — where a UI exists — run through a real browser via their Playwright specs in CI's SDK-then-UI order.
  • Labs 01–16 and 18 were verified in the earlier first-user verification pass (FIRST-USER-VERIFICATION) and run on every main push by the Run every cookbook lab (API and UI) CI job, which now includes 19, 20 and 21.
  • Contract tests keep this matrix's inputs honest: test_cookbook_steps_contract.py pins the catalog to the READMEs, test_cookbook_doc_contract.py pins the lab folders, the lab-21 tripwire pins the no-executor boundary, and test_alpha_scope_claims.py pins the simulated-provider claims.
